hypothesis: At a small fixed residual width, 16x16/32x32 memory heads or local convolution improve held-out language loss enough to justify cost; halving the MLP may improve learning per CPU second.
primary_metric: Mean paired development cross-entropy after equal token exposure; confirmation is an internal reused-region check.
minimum_useful_effect: 0.02 nat/token mean CE reduction; no universal capability or superiority claim.
success_rule: Exploratory advance only if mean CE improves >=0.02 and all three paired seeds agree, with all fidelity/completion gates passed. Speed and state memory reported separately.
futility_rule: Stop any nonfinite/fidelity-failing arm. Stop screening at 900 training wall seconds, extensions at 300 training seconds each, total 1800 training wall seconds. Incomplete matched grids cannot claim a completed comparison.

authorization.user_approval_reference: 2026-10-21 user: Let us run with a smaller, faster model ... go ahead and run with those new experiments. Earlier user requests code/results and reconstruction placeholders, no big files.
authorization.approved_resources: Existing user-provided CPU workspace only; no GPU or new external compute resources. This active instruction supersedes the historical paused/mounted-macOS-workflow scope for this run.
authorization.max_cost: No purchases or paid resource provisioning.
authorization.max_walltime: Self-imposed <=30 minutes training; setup, fidelity, evaluation and publication additional.
authorization.local_cpu_budget: Up to 4 of available 8 CPU cores during training; <=2 CPU hours; selected from 1/2/4 threads by throughput.

design.mechanism_equations: S_decay=exp(g)*S; u=write-beta*<k,S_decay v>/||v||^2; S=S_decay+u*k*v^T (normalized v); y=q^T S/sqrt(K). Optional depthwise causal FIR4 on qkv, initialized identity.
design.control_rationale: All models: width192, 3 layers, vocab4096, tied embedding/head, squared ReLU MLP, pre-RMSNorm. Fixed readout width96 across recurrent arms. Lean Transformer gives a practical speed/quality reference; not parameter matched.
design.seed_selection_method: Three sequential fresh seeds; independent of outcomes; shared named backbone initialization and identical training windows within each paired seed.
design.parameter_counts: Exact counts written by qualify.py to PROFILE.json before language training.
design.matching_track: Screen: token/update matched, not parameter/FLOP/walltime matched. Extension: equal additional training seconds from screen endpoint, not equal lifetime compute.
design.compute_accounting: Per-step measured training walltime, target exposures and process peak RSS; no inferred FLOP match.

data.split_boundaries: Original SHA256 whole-document split preserved; retokenized losslessly. Prefix4096 GPT-2 vocabulary not fitted to holdouts.
data.research_wide_region_reuse_audit: Development and confirmation documents were used in the earlier 124M pilot. This is internal ablation evidence, not a globally unseen transfer test.
data.teacher_and_objective: No teacher; next-token cross entropy, including text-to-EOT, document resets before EOT.

training.updates: Screen S=max(16,min(512,floor(900*0.75*min_arm_throughput/(18*1024)))) at maximin-speed thread count in {1,2,4}. Freeze in PROFILE.json before corpus training; 18 arm/seed runs. Extension: k8, selected best recurrent variant, Transformer, seed25101, 300 training seconds each, continue next window.
training.target_exposures_per_trial: Screen S*1024 each. Extension measured exactly; no wrapping within an epoch, deterministic re-shuffle at next epoch.
training.accessible_history: 128 independent-token windows at training/evaluation; no evidence for longer-context retention.
training.state_carry_and_detach: Reset at each window; no cross-window state. This is a reset-window architecture screen, not persistent-state hierarchy training.
training.document_reset_policy: Reset before every EOT input, and window start; conv cache resets too.
training.optimizer_schedule: AdamW beta(.9,.95), eps1e-8; weight_decay0.1 except embeddings/norms/decays/bias; clip global grad norm1; peak LR0.003; linear warmup first min(20,max(4,S//10)) steps then cosine to0.0003. Extension starts at0.0015 and cosine decays by measured extension training time to0.0003, all arms same rule.
training.checkpoint_selection_rule: Use final fixed-exposure screen checkpoint for every arm/seed. Select variant by mean dev CE, tie within1e-6 by name. Extension endpoints final by time budget. No best-of-checkpoint selection.

execution.hardware: Linux x86_64; 8-core cgroup CPU quota, 8GiB memory; no CUDA.
execution.runtime_versions: Python3.12; torch2.9.1+cpu; numpy existing runtime; tiktoken0.14.0; full environment captured before execution.
execution.source_ownership_and_concurrent_writers: Single agent owns new unique run directory; prior sources unchanged; no other training jobs started.
execution.canary_matrix: All 6 arms, seeds25101/25102, FP64/FP32, B2 T19 with 2 document resets; chunk vs independent recurrence output/state/parameter grads/AdamW; full vs split(6,13), future-token causality, reset isolation; nonzero conv history. Synthetic throughput B8 T128, 2 warmup +5 measured steps at1/2/4threads.
execution.cost_estimate: <=30 minutes training on existing CPU host; no resource provisioning.

evaluation.primary_endpoint: Screen final fixed-token checkpoints: dev first16384 next-token targets. After selecting recurrent variant, freeze all screen checkpoints and evaluate all arms/seeds on first32768 confirmation targets twice. Extension endpoint dev and confirmation scored after fixed time, plus fixed prompt samples.
evaluation.duplicate_policy: Repeat confirmation CE FP32; require absolute mean difference <=1e-7. Report any failure.
evaluation.uncertainty_method: Show all three paired seeds, mean and sample SD of CE differences; n=3 descriptive only, no strong statistical claim.
evaluation.multiple_comparison_policy: Six-arm exploratory screen with development selection; reused confirmation not an untouched external dataset; no familywise-significance claim.

deployment.prefill_decode_protocol: Final extension seed25101 models: prefill128 and decode64, same fixed token sequence; report persistent state at128/256, weight bytes, RSS separately.
deployment.warmup_and_synchronization: CPU synchronous; 2 warmups then5 timed prefill and64 individual decode timings.
deployment.memory_components: Weight tensor bytes, persistent state tensor bytes, peak process RSS separately; RSS includes runtime/training allocations and is not isolated deployment memory.
deployment.latency_statistics: p50/p95 decode token time and prefill time, batch1.

evidence.protocol_sha256: External digest in RUN_REGISTRY.json avoids circular self-hash.
evidence.source_manifest: SOURCE_MANIFEST.json frozen before training; preserve any later fixes separately.
evidence.checkpoint_manifest: CHECKPOINTS.json; checkpoint bodies retained locally and excluded from Git per user; reconstruction recipe and hashes included.
evidence.preservation_policy: Commit code, tokenizer, source/data/checkpoint hashes, compact metrics and samples; exclude corpus arrays and weights, include reconstruction placeholders.
evidence.cleanup_receipt: CLEANUP.json; do not delete checkpoint evidence or affect unrelated processes.

decision.reason: Frozen before synthetic qualification and language training.
decision.next_experiment: Decide only after all outcomes; no automatic unbounded run.
